name: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan
summary: Erdoğan combines religious and family conservatism with export-led development, infrastructure investment and a powerful executive presidency. His governments expanded social services and domestic energy production while restricting independent media and opposition activity.

sources.usedFor: His own General Assembly speeches: Crimea, occupation, aid, trade, NATO, Turkic states, Gaza and the Holocaust

abortion-legal.rationale: He called abortion murder and announced a bill to restrict it.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: At the UN in 2021 he said annexation and illegal occupation must end, that Turkey does not recognise the annexation of Crimea, and he repeatedly calls Armenian control of Azerbaijani land an illegitimate occupation. Integrator review: lowered from +2 because the “without the consent of its people” clause is not stated, and Turkey’s own position on northern Cyprus pulls the other way.

ban-cartels.rationale: In his 2021 opening he announced the government would act firmly against companies that disrupt competition, abuse market dominance or fix prices arbitrarily.

central-bank-independence.rationale: He repeatedly directed interest-rate policy, though later backed advisers’ restrictive monetary program.

collective-bargaining.rationale: He defended constitutional protection for civil servants’ collective bargaining and bargaining bonuses.

collective-defense.rationale: He said NATO has a responsibility to protect Turkish borders and holds that allies who expect Turkey to defend them under Article 5 must in turn address Turkey's security concerns.

death-penalty.rationale: He proposed restoring capital punishment for coup conspirators.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: The 2011 programme (Turkish record checked) expands social assistance and sets the aim of ending absolute poverty by 2023, pairing aid with job referral rather than cutting it for dependency.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: He championed the presidential system and sought popular presidential mandates.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: He defended different social roles for men and women on grounds of their different natures.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: The 2011 programme (Turkish record checked) calls differences a wealth to be removed as a source of conflict and asks for a constitution that treats social diversity as a wealth; he does not discuss cohesion costs. Integrator review: low, because the 2011 words (“toplumsal çeşitliliği bir zenginlik”) stand against a record on Kurdish politics that pulls the other way.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: He announced a 2053 net-zero target and sector transformation, while saying Turkey will balance climate cooperation against its development goals.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: He used a prolonged post-coup emergency to dismiss officials and detain suspected opponents.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: He called for rapidly increasing domestic natural-gas output and exploration.

expand-nuclear.rationale: He endorsed Akkuyu and further development of nuclear energy.

force-without-un.rationale: He said Turkey seeks no one's permission when carrying out cross-border operations for its security, and the Syria operations ran without Security Council approval.

free-trade.rationale: The 2011 programme (Turkish record checked) pledges to keep defending free trade and capital movements, and at the UN in 2018 he said Turkey has always favoured free trade and warned against protectionism; this is his stated line, not an unqualified record.

future-generations.rationale: In 2021 he said Turkey's green development policy carries its responsibility to humanity, citizens and future generations.

gender-social-construct.rationale: He said men and women were created differently with different natures, and in 2024 called 'gender neutralisation' a war against creation.

holocaust-denial.rationale: At the UN in 2025 he described genocide 'like the Holocaust' as a shameful, barbaric concept of mass extermination, and in 2014 he said Turkey opposes anti-Semitism; he accepts the Holocaust as historians describe it.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: In 2019 he called it unacceptable that nuclear-armed states forbid Turkey its own nuclear-tipped missiles ('this I cannot accept'), though he did not say Turkey intends to build them.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: He explicitly threatened to eliminate Twitter access and backed platform blocking.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: He said Turkey has never made concessions on the free-market economy and will not, but this is a defence against currency pressure, not a general claim.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: His openings of parliament honour all martyrs as blessed and in 2016 he asked the government to make 15 July an official memorial, the Day of Democracy and Freedom.

military-guardian-role.rationale: In the 2011 programme (Turkish record checked) he says the 1982 constitution was imposed by an intervention and that his government strengthened the national will against tutelage, and his 2012-2014 openings of parliament condemn coups and post-coup institutions placing themselves above parliament.

national-resource-control.rationale: He described energy independence through Turkish oil and gas production as a national objective.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: He championed İmam Hatip religious schools, saying their purpose is more than training imams, and attacked the 2000s curbs on them.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: He said that under the new system the president will be an active member of a political party, the opposite of standing above party politics.

open-borders.rationale: He defended controlled refugee return and border security rather than eliminating borders.

party-controls-media.rationale: His government closed critical media outlets and restricted online platforms.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: His 2026 program placed national culture, family and unity at the centre of development.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: At the UN in 2024 he raised the rights of Uyghur Turks in China and Turkey backs Turkish Cypriots; he speaks for kin communities abroad.

public-ownership.rationale: The same programme (Turkish record checked) says his government gave importance to privatising electricity generation and distribution, the opposite of keeping energy publicly owned.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: He celebrated substantial minimum-wage increases and pledged to protect workers’ welfare.

refugee-return.rationale: On Syrians he said those who want to go back will return of their own will and that he would not deport them; this backs return as a choice, not a general principle.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: In 2019 he said Turkey closed its IMF book in May 2013 so the Fund could not rule countries behind the scenes with political criteria.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: He sought to remove public-institution headscarf restrictions and defended religious freedom for wearers.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: At the UN he asks for an international system that removes global injustice and economic inequality (2023) and for aligning the global financial architecture with leaving no one behind (2025).

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: At the UN he calls official development assistance the main resource for the poorest countries, cites Turkey's aid against the 0.7 per cent target (2016) and pledged annual aid to the least developed countries (2011); he does not state it as a duty.

right-to-secede.rationale: He took the presidential oath to the 'indivisible integrity' of the country and nation (2014, 2018) and in 2017 rejected the Iraqi Kurdistan independence referendum as having no standing.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: He rejected legitimising LGBT movements and framed their public recognition as a threat to national existence.

separate-church-state.rationale: He publicly endorsed secular constitutional government while expanding state support for religion and religious schooling.

social-market-economy.rationale: He credits regulation with letting markets work freely in a competitive setting and says economic policy was joined with strong social policy (2011 programme, Turkish record checked).

state-directs-investment.rationale: The 2011 programme (Turkish record checked) keeps the state investment-incentive system started in 2009 and strengthens the regional and sectoral incentive system.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: At the UN in 2022 he presented Turkey as a strong NATO ally celebrating 70 years of membership and in 2025 announced the 2026 NATO summit in Ankara, though he also speaks of Turkey keeping its own axis.

strong-leader.rationale: He campaigned for an executive presidency concentrating governing power in his office.

suppress-opposition.rationale: He personally drove post-coup purges encompassing journalists and independent organisations.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: His development program combines domestic technology and defense innovation with family and national culture.

trade-surplus.rationale: He described his strategy as growth through investment, employment, production and a current-account surplus, and links low rates to exports.

traditional-family.rationale: He described protecting the family as protecting the foundation of the nation.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: In 2019 and 2020 he said Turkey has a state tradition of over 2,200 years with uninterrupted government experience and that this continuity means the nation never accepted captivity.

unions-good.rationale: He praised expanded union membership and union rights as achievements.

universal-healthcare.rationale: In the 2011 programme he read to parliament (wording checked in the Turkish record) his government 'recognises health care as a basic human right' and makes covering all citizens by general health insurance its main goal.

notes:
Whole-career reference review supplemented by full interview and recent labor and development texts. Later orthodox monetary-policy support is distinguished from earlier low-rate advocacy. Unavailable UN speech archives were not used to assign additional positions. Every remaining null was checked against the collected evidence. Auditor identification: the runtime identifies this assistant as GPT-6/Codex but does not expose an exact version or variant; gpt-6 is the available identifier, not an asserted variant.

Merged with an independent claude-sonnet-5-5 audit: 13 answers taken from it, 5 agreed, 1 conflicts settled by the integrator.

claude-sonnet-5-5 notes: Independent second pass. Searched UN General Assembly addresses (2023, 2024), 2017 referendum campaign speeches, 2016 death-penalty remarks, 2014 women's-conference speech, 2015 education speech, 2018 and 2022 interest-rate and free-market remarks, climate summits, NATO and Syria remarks, 2022 refugee remarks and the 2025 PKK dissolution speech. Many original pages (tccb.gov.tr, UN PDF, Washington Post) blocked automated download, so most quotes come via press or official readouts of his speeches, which caps confidence at medium. Answers about what governments did (Syria operations, imam hatip expansion) rest on his own statements about them. Themes still thin: economy (welfare, health, ownership), liberty and civil rights, ecology beyond climate, technology.

claude-sonnet-5-5 deepening pass 2026-11-02 (rules 3): read all 85 Turkish Grand National Assembly utterances of Erdoğan in ParlaMint 5.0 (2011 government programme, 2011-2022 openings of parliament; English machine translation) and checked the 2011 programme against the Turkish record (TBMM Tutanak Dergisi, 24th term, 6th sitting); read his 14 UN General Assembly addresses 2007-2025 (UNGDC, official English) and the two Security Council speeches (2009, 2014). Answers resting on the Turkish-checked 2011 programme are marked in their rationales; the rest rest on machine translation or on UN English and are at most medium. Not answerable from these records: most economy, liberty and ecology statements.
